subject: Residency & transfer evidence for Nimbus Health POC
messages:
From: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:12:00Z
Subject: Residency & transfer evidence for POC

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Nimbus is excited to move forward with a short POC. Before we start ingesting PHI-adjacent test data, security needs a clear picture of where inference actually runs and whether any customer data could cross borders during normal operation or failover. Can you confirm: 

- Which regions can we guarantee will process inference requests for the hosted Redwood API (for EU customers)?
- Are there any subprocessors that will access request payloads or model outputs (logs, traces)?
- Under what circumstances would data transit outside the EU (e.g., model fallbacks, cache miss routing, control-plane operations)?
- Retention & deletion: what is the default retention for request logs, KV cache, and persistent artifacts, and how do you securely purge on demand?

We prefer concise answers + evidence we can share with our security review (matrix, redacted SOC2, short dataflow diagram). Procurement has been cc'd for contract timelines.

Thanks,
Eve Thompson
Head of Security (acting)
Nimbus Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency & transfer evidence for POC

Eve — great questions, and totally reasonable for the POC. Short summary first, then the evidence items we attached.

High-level guarantees (hosted API, EU tenancy):
- Regional processing: For EU-region customers using the "eu" residency option, inference requests (compute and ephemeral KV/cache) are processed in our EU clusters (primary: eu-west-1 / secondary: eu-west-3) by default. Persistent artifacts (logs, metrics) remain in the EU unless you enable cross-region analytics.
- Subprocessors with access to request payloads:
  - AWS (EC2/EBS/EKS) — runs model inference and ephemeral storage for EU clusters.
  - HashiCorp Vault (secrets management) — access limited to control plane ops staff via RBAC; secrets are not logged.
  - Cloudflare (ingress/CDN/edge) — only metadata and health checks; payloads are TLS-encrypted and routed to the configured regional cluster.
  - Datadog (observability) — only non-PII telemetry by default; you can opt out.

Cross-border behavior and failover:
- Failover policy: If EU capacity is temporarily exhausted, requests can be routed to a compatible model variant in another region as a controlled fallback. This behavior is off by default for enterprise customers and must be approved in the tenant settings.
- Control plane: Our control plane (management APIs, billing) is hosted in the US. Control-plane metadata (tenant IDs, billing activity timestamps) may traverse US-hosted services; customer request payloads are not sent to the control plane for inference.
- Third-party transfers: We do not move raw request payloads to third-party analytics unless explicitly enabled in account settings.

Retention & deletion:
- KV cache / model context: Ephemeral by default, TTL configurable per-deployment (default 30 minutes).
- Request logs (metadata + redacted snippets): Default retention 30 days; can be shortened to 0 days or extended under contract.
- Full-text traces & debug logs: Collected only if you opt into debug mode; otherwise not retained.
- Deletion: We support an automated purge workflow: a deletion request (API or Console) triggers immediate soft-delete and a background purge within 72 hours across primary storage and backups. For contractual one-off purges we provide signed confirmation when the process completes.

Evidence attached in this thread:
- Redwood_residency_matrix_Q2_2027.pdf — region-by-region processing and subprocessors table (redacted).
- SOC2-Type2-redacted-2027.pdf — latest attestation (redacted controls list).
- dataflow-eu-us-failover.png — simplified dataflow and failover path diagram.

Next steps: If Nimbus needs a stricter guarantee (no cross-border failover, EU-only control plane), we offer a Private deployment option (VPC/on-prem bundle) or a Dedicated EU-only tenancy with control-plane localization — both are available under enterprise terms. Happy to set up a short call with our security engineering lead to walk through the matrix.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_residency_matrix_Q2_2027.pdf (attachment), SOC2-Type2-redacted-2027.pdf (attachment), dataflow-eu-us-failover.png (attachment)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@nimbushealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T08:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency & transfer evidence for POC

Adding a few technical clarifications (brief):
- Caching specifics: Prefix/KV caching is shard-local to the region where the request was served. We never asynchronously replicate KV cache entries to other regions.
- Backups & snapshots: Daily backups of logs/metrics are stored encrypted; EU tenancy backups are kept in EU storage endpoints. Our backup retention window follows the same retention policy as logs and can be shortened by request.
- Encryption & keys: Customer data at rest uses AES-256; keys for hosted customers are managed by our KMS in the region. For higher assurance you can bring your own key (BYOK) via a supported HSM provider — we have integrations with several EU-based KMS partners.

If you want samples of the automated deletion audit we run (timestamped job records), tell us the scope and we can produce a redacted sample for the Nimbus review.

— Jonas
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, Oliver Park <oliver.park@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency & transfer evidence for POC

Thanks Vivek and Jonas — that helps a lot. A few quick asks before we kick off the POC next week: 

1) Can you share the redacted deletion-audit sample Jonas mentioned (just a single job run showing timestamps and affected storage buckets)?
2) We need a written statement to confirm that for the POC we can disable cross-border failover and keep all inference and logs in EU. Is that something you can provide as a short addendum to the POC SOW?
3) If possible, send a short invite for a 30-minute call (security + infra) — Tue/Wed next week looks best for us.

If you can drop the items into the Drive link, procurement will start the SOW review in parallel.

Best,
Eve

Nimbus Health (procurement cc'd)
